threats.threat: Cross-tenant object ID or query substitution
threats.control: server tenant derivation; tenant-filtered repository methods; private reference closure; cache/search tenant keys

threats.threat: Model or client forges founder/lawyer decision
threats.control: human-only route and principal kind; no decision tool; membership/assignment and server actor; CSRF

threats.threat: Approval survives draft, context or evidence change
threats.control: immutable bundle; material epochs; transactional decision/finalize fence; exact bundle founder then lawyer

threats.threat: Prompt injection in documents, feedback or legal text
threats.control: tainted data envelopes; strict tool schemas; no arbitrary DB/network/shell; server authority; render escaping

threats.threat: SSRF through direct URL, redirect, DNS rebinding or embedded resource
threats.control: registry destination; manual redirect validation; DNS and connect-time network check; no parser network
separate authoritative-source curator; immutable snapshots and dates/hash; authoritative URL metadata from fetch adapter; citation existence and content checks

threats.threat: Lost context update or inference laundered as verified fact
threats.control: typed proposal; expected version CAS; append provenance; human attestation; unknown/conflicting state preserved

threats.threat: Adaptive patch indirectly removes required evidence or approvals
threats.control: outside-model immutable kernel; strict typed allowlist and whole-candidate diff; frozen regression; CAS; no free-form prompts

threats.threat: PII/secrets in traces, legal search, screenshots or public repository
threats.control: synthetic fixtures; minimization before model/search/trace; metadata allowlist; secret exclusion and artifact review

threats.threat: HTML/Markdown injection executes or fetches exfiltration URL
threats.control: escaped clause text; no raw HTML; no remote images/scripts; sanitized links; CSP; authenticated asset handler

threats.threat: Malicious parser input or resource exhaustion
threats.control: format/size limits; sandboxed no-network parsing; deadline; no macros/external relationships; reject unsupported files

threats.threat: Email exfiltration, spoofed webhook, click-to-approve or duplicate delivery
threats.control: server recipient IDs; fixed links/template; webhook verification and dedupe; GET read only; provider state separate from workflow

threats.threat: Stale/replayed service event or expired worker commits
threats.control: producer authentication; timestamp/nonce or event key; idempotency payload hash; leases/fencing; state CAS

threats.threat: Role switcher or public demo becomes real authentication
threats.control: explicit simulation label; synthetic tenant; demo mode separated at server; production refuses demo principals/routes

threats.threat: Public corpus/memory cross-contaminated with tenant content
threats.control: tenant-owned legal copies; separate authoritative-source writer; tenant-private notes/embeddings/cache/harness memory; no automatic cross-tenant learning

threats.threat: Security log erased or secret leaked during error handling
threats.control: append-only app audit; allowlist errors; sensitive write fails on audit transaction failure; external trace outage does not block
